name: Article Forge
tagline: Article Forge generates unique, full-length articles from a keyword using AI trained on billions of web pages. It understands topics deeply enough to research, write, and structure articles automatically, including relevant headings, images, and videos. SEO agencies use it for bulk content production across niche sites.
